decision_enabled: Determine whether current stable IDs, portable exports, provenance and digests are sufficient until a real second Cell exists, and isolate the smallest cross-Cell envelope that would be required before any federation/runtime/protocol work.

existing_cz_foundations.boundary: A Cell is a local governance/coordination boundary. No current record grants authority over another Cell.

properties: stable UUIDs across Projects, Actors, Opportunities, Proposals, Commitments, Contributions, Artifacts, Claims, Evidence and Verifications
existing_cz_foundations.boundary: UUID identity supports stable references but does not identify the authoritative origin Cell, remote namespace, local interpretation or trust status.

existing_cz_foundations.structural_limit: The export does not currently include an origin Cell identity/IRI or a formal remote-reference/import envelope.
existing_cz_foundations.boundary: Export is a snapshot; it does not grant authority, rights, truth, trust or adoption.
Provenance/derivation is preserved without converting source into truth.
Digest/integrity metadata does not authenticate another Cell or authorize imports.
External mapping does not make external or local competency assertions universally equivalent.

precedents.boundary: Useful external vocabulary/envelope only. Do not recast all CZ domain objects as ActivityStreams internally.

use: object identifier under originating server authority
precedents.boundary: ActivityPub is a social federation protocol. CZ does not need inbox/outbox/federated-server runtime before a real second Cell requires exchange.
Use only if external interoperability benefits from semantic IRIs/contexts. No RDF store, SPARQL or graph database is required.
Cross-system provenance remains provenance, not truth, verification or trust.
BagIt can package exported files if needed. A checksum-valid bag is not an authorized or trusted import.
Digest fields detect content/representation corruption; the RFC explicitly does not define authentication, authorization or privacy.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: cz.operating-loop.v1 JSON/Markdown + stable UUIDs + SHA256/canonical digests
When cross-Cell exchange exists, map local UUIDs to an origin-controlled absolute IRI or another explicit globally scoped identifier; JSON-LD/ActivityStreams patterns are sufficient.
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: No loss exists while one Cell is authoritative. With a second Cell, a naked UUID lacks an explicit origin namespace/authority and dereferenceable external identity.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: A minimal envelope only when needed: schema version, origin Cell identifier/URI, object type, origin object identifier, object/material version where applicable, exportedAt, digest, provenance/derivation relation, and local disposition REFERENCE|IMPORTED_COPY|DERIVED.
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: Once two independent Cells exchange records, CZ must distinguish a remote reference from a local imported copy or a locally derived object, while preserving which Cell was authoritative for the source and which exact version/digest was observed. The current portable export does not encode that cross-Cell disposition/origin.
architecture_decisions.falsifier: If no second independently governed Cell exists, or if the first exchange can be handled safely by a documented manual export plus explicit source URL/digest without persisting cross-Cell references, do not build this envelope.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: BagIt-style manifest/checksums only if multi-file export/import becomes operationally useful
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: None for current single JSON/Markdown exports. A bundle manifest becomes useful only when multiple files must be transferred and completeness/integrity validated as one package.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: RFC 9530 Content-Digest/Repr-Digest if CZ later exposes HTTP interchange endpoints
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: None without an HTTP cross-Cell interchange endpoint.
None demonstrated before a real second Cell and real federation use case.
None demonstrated for current portability/provenance properties.
None; verification/trust remains contextual to each Cell and decision.
None; interoperability must not silently merge authority domains.

minimal_second_cell_experiment.precondition: A second independently governed Cell actually exists.
journey: Cell A exports one selected object/history slice
Cell B receives bytes plus source/origin reference
Cell B records whether it is only referencing, importing a copy, or deriving a local object
Cell B preserves source provenance and local decision authority
Cell B may disagree with Cell A verification/interpretation without rewriting Cell A history
minimal_second_cell_experiment.property_under_test: Can two Cells exchange one record without sharing governance, reputation, membership or truth authority?
minimal_second_cell_experiment.success: Origin, exact source version/digest, local disposition and provenance remain inspectable while each Cell retains independent policy and verification decisions.
minimal_second_cell_experiment.failure_signal_for_extension: Manual export/source/digest cannot distinguish remote reference vs local copy/derivation or loses authoritative origin.

privacy_security_constraints: Do not export private/personal/sensitive content merely because an object has a stable ID.
Cross-Cell export/import inherits DATA-FOUNDATION visibility, blocking, minimisation and lawful-processing constraints.
Imported personal data does not become anonymous because its source used UUIDs or hashes.
Do not auto-accept remote authority, roles, memberships, trust or verification decisions.
Remote digest integrity is not authentication or authorization.
Do not publish a cross-Cell directory of people/relations by default.
External URLs/IRIs are references and may become unavailable; essential imported records need local survivable copies only when justified.
closure_rule: If no real second independently governed Cell exists, current portable exports + stable IDs + provenance/digests are sufficient to continue. Defer cross-Cell envelope/federation implementation.
